name: processcontrol
description: Set a repository up for ProcessControl and write pull request descriptions as claims it can test.

interface.shortDescription: Pull requests tested in the running app
interface.longDescription: ProcessControl tests pull requests: an agent builds and launches the app at the pull request's commit on a machine of its own and tests the claims in its title and description. This plugin teaches the agent to set a repository up for it and to write pull request descriptions as claims it can test.
defaultPrompt: Set up ProcessControl for this repository
